results.claim_ceiling: sampling/geoclimatic identifiability of field-pair contrasts only; no relative historical vs environmental causal contribution
results.climate_variables: WorldClim2.1 long-term BIO5 max warmest-month temperature and BIO12 annual precipitation, 1970-2000
